description: Say a line in a chat channel on the current lot. The message is distributed by the server to all Sims in range/channel-permission; other bots observe it as a VMChatEvent. Costs nothing; prerequisite is being on the lot with send permission for the channel. Messages > 200 chars are truncated server-side; leading '/' is reserved for admin commands.

args.name: text
args.description: The line to speak (will be truncated to 200 chars server-side)
